mcq.question: A parent holds `shared_ptr` children and each child holds a `shared_ptr` to its parent. What happens when the last outside pointer goes?

options.A: Nothing is freed: the cycle keeps every use count above zero

mcq.explanation: Reference counting cannot see cycles. Making the back link a `weak_ptr` fixes it.

mcq.question: Why does the asset cache store `weak_ptr<Image>` instead of `shared_ptr<Image>`?

options.B: `shared_ptr` cannot be stored in a map
options.C: So the cache never keeps an image alive that no slide uses

mcq.explanation: The cache only observes. When the last slide drops an image it is freed, and `lock()` returns null.

bonus.question: Many style guides say "prefer unique_ptr, use shared_ptr sparingly". Why is shared ownership harder to reason about?
